  gfm:
    output-file: tower-model-physical.generated.md

  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false

unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs:
    - assets/quarto/03-estructura-formats-referenciacio/tower-model-scene.svg
  outputs:
    - assets/img/generated/03-estructura-formats-referenciacio/tower-model-physical.svg
---

```{python}
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

root = next(p for p in (Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents)
            if (p / ".unaltraweb/computations.yml").is_file())
scene = (root / "assets/quarto/03-estructura-formats-referenciacio/tower-model-scene.svg").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
tree = ET.fromstring(scene)
towers = {e.attrib["data-tower-id"]: e.attrib for e in tree.iter() if "data-tower-id" in e.attrib}
spans = [e.attrib for e in tree.iter() if "data-span-id" in e.attrib]
labels = []
for span in spans:
    labels.append((int(span["data-label-x"]), 60, [
        "Capa trams · línia", f"id_tram (text): {span['data-span-id']}",
        f"torre_inici (text): {span['data-start-tower']}", f"torre_final (text): {span['data-end-tower']}",
    ]))
for identifier, tower in towers.items():
    height = f"{float(tower['data-height-m']):.1f}".replace(".", ",")
    labels.append((int(tower["data-label-x"]), 450, [
        "Capa torres · punt", f"id_torre (text): {identifier}", f"altura_m (decimal): {height}",
    ]))
annotations = ['<g id="annotations" font-family="Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif" font-size="28" fill="#21313c" text-anchor="middle">']
for x, y, lines in labels:
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        annotations.append(f'<text x="{x}" y="{y + 40*i}" font-weight="{700 if i == 0 else 400}">{escape(line)}</text>')
annotations.append('<text x="600" y="599">Fitxer: xarxa.gpkg · CRS: EPSG:25831 · Altures en m</text>')
annotations.append('</g>')
scene = scene.replace("Torres i trams d'una mateixa xarxa", "Model físic: capes i camps dins d'un GeoPackage")
scene = scene.replace("<!-- model-annotations -->", "\n".join(annotations))
output = root / "assets/img/generated/03-estructura-formats-referenciacio/tower-model-physical.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(scene, encoding="utf-8")
```
